decisions.reason: Displaying randomly assigned commissions does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard listing.
The source addresses the recipient dashboard and NFT attributes, not the reward values shown in the selected NFT detail view.
Commission visibility does not affect NFT cover, image, metadata-image, or wallet asset presentation.
The candidate already requires randomly assigned no-code rewards, including commissions, to appear in NFT attributes; the source restates that existing state without changing it.
The source requires display on the recipient dashboard and NFT attributes but does not establish a new leaderboard requirement.
Recipient-specific commission display does not change public mint, pool, referral, or draw-counter statistics.
The commission-display decision does not affect resolution of NFT metadata, image, or other asset endpoints.
The candidate already requires commissions to be displayed through the dashboard, and the source does not specifically change fiat-buyer access methods or reward-access behavior.
Random commission display is unrelated to landing-page book-cover placement, size, overlap, or visibility.
The source does not change badge eligibility or badge email-notification behavior.
The source establishes product display behavior but does not direct a change to the About-page copy.
The source does not require a definite FAQ revision; it mentions UI-note changes only conditionally if no ticket is generated, which remains unresolved.
